title: Company Nonrenewal of a Named Non-Owner Policy
content:
The company nonrenews a Named Non-Owner Policy term only for a reason in its nonrenewal reason list.

A nonrenewal notice is valid only when its mailing date is at least the residence state's days in the Owner Auto Policy's nonrenewal notice days by state before the expiration date; the test compares the notice's mailing date with the term's expiration date.

When the notice cannot be mailed in time, the renewal is issued in the highest package the named insured qualifies for.

| Notice mailed | Validity |
|---|---|
| the state's days or more before expiration | valid |
| fewer than the state's days before expiration | not valid; the renewal is issued in the highest package the named insured qualifies for |

*Hypothetical:* with a state figure of 45 days and an expiration date of 1 December, a notice mailed on 17 October (45 days before) is valid; one mailed on 18 October is not.
